t: This is Swan House, a Grade II* listed house at 17 Chelsea Embankment, facing the Thames. Richard Norman Shaw designed it, and it was built in 1876 for the artistic patrons Wickham and Elizabeth Flower. It belongs to both the Queen Anne Revival and the Arts and Crafts movement. The authors of a guide to London's architecture call it the finest Queen Anne Revival domestic building in London. Shaw was among Britain's greatest architects, best known for country houses and commercial buildings.
